title: Family Travel Hack Day No. 70 of 365: Let your kids take photos and videos during your trips. 📸✈️
description:
Family Travel Hack Day No. 70 of 365: Let your kids take photos and videos during your trips. 📸✈️

Most parents document everything.

We take the photos.
We film the videos.
We capture the memories.

But one of the best family travel hacks we ever discovered?

Let the kids be the photographer.

It started during one of our trips when Blaire asked if she could use the phone to “take a picture of something cool.”

At first I hesitated.

What if she drops it?
What if she takes blurry photos?

But we said yes.

And what she captured surprised us.

Photos of Daddy Barry laughing while trying street food.
Videos of random pigeons chasing crumbs.
Close ups of tiny things we would normally walk past.

Kids see the world differently.

When you let them document the trip, the whole experience changes.

Here’s why we love this when traveling with kids:

📷 It gives them ownership of the trip
They stop feeling like passengers and start feeling like explorers.

📷 It builds creativity
Kids start noticing colors, signs, food, people, and funny moments.

📷 It keeps them engaged
Instead of saying “I’m bored,” they start hunting for things to film.

📷 It creates the best surprise memories
Some of the funniest videos in our family archive were filmed by the kids themselves.

Interesting fact: When children take photos of experiences themselves, their brains process the memory more deeply because they are actively participating instead of just observing.

So now during family vacations, we actually encourage it.

“Find something interesting.”
“Take a video of that.”
“Show us what you see.”

Sometimes their photos are blurry.

Sometimes the camera is pointing at the floor.

But sometimes…

They capture pure magic.

And honestly?

That’s exactly why we create family travel content here on BarBelle EverAfter.

Because documenting these little moments turns trips into lifelong stories.
